$comment: The faces the asset commands draw with (image, deck, video, merch, illustrate). tokens.css sets Inter for every role, the display included, and IBM Plex Mono for keys, hosts and IDs; the share-image editor set its headlines in Funnel Display and its new-feature card in IBM Plex Sans, so those are drawn in Inter here (tokens win). Inter SemiBold and Plex Mono Medium and SemiBold come from the editor's server fonts (agd-playground src/fonts/inkbox-og), SIL Open Font License 1.1 (Inter-LICENSE.txt, IBM-Plex-OFL.txt).
